items.quote: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians
items.claim: Israel witnessed a great work performed by the LORD against the Egyptians

items.quote: and the people feared the LORD
items.claim: The people experienced fear of the LORD

items.quote: and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses
items.claim: The people had faith in the LORD and his servant Moses
items.object: the LORD, and his servant Moses
